title: The Burger Edit: AI cinematic food ad
summary: A 65 s square AI-generated (Seedance 2.5 / CapCut watermark) food-and-lifestyle ad: a streetwear model walks a neon city street with a burger bag, macro hero shots of a smash burger, sizzling patty, ingredients levitating and stacking, cheese pulls, then the model eating and friends at a table, all punctuated by hand-brushed slogan type ('CRAVE THE MOMENT', 'BIG ENERGY', 'MAKE IT YOURS'). Glossy, high-energy, very 'AI commercial'.
fit_reason: Fully AI-generated lifestyle/food spot with a synthetic talent: off-audience, no product UI, and breaks the AI-video rules.

palette.mood: dark, warm, high-contrast food photography with neon bokeh

typography.display: hand-brushed condensed marker script (all caps) for slogans; condensed bold sans (Bebas/Anton-like) for later lines
typography.size_behaviour: large, stacked 2-3 lines in a corner or lower-third; two-colour (white + red #e82830 / gold #f8b858)
typography.notes: Last word of a slogan switches colour ('MOMENT' red, 'BIG ENERGY' gold, 'YOURS' red). Garbled AI-generated subtitle bars with a red number badge appear in some shots (artefact).

text_animation: slogan words punch in one line at a time
lower-third white condensed caption fades up ('YOU DON'T JUST EAT IT.')
captions: phrase - big condensed white text lower-centre, no box, two words at a time
motion: macro slow-motion ingredient levitation and stack
slow push-in on hero burger with steam
transitions: match cut from bag to burger

sound.voiceover: yes - female VO with hype lines ('Crave the moment. You ready for this? Bold. Juicy. Unstoppable.')

signature_moves: two-colour brush-script slogan stacked in a corner
levitating ingredient stack in slow motion

best_segments.what: Hero burger with 'CRAVE THE MOMENT' brush slogan, red last word

recreate.how: Needs AI video generation (Seedance/Veo) for all footage; typography overlay is easy in CapCut or HTML. Not suitable for SaaSSuite beyond borrowing the two-colour slogan treatment.
recreate.prompt: Cinematic dark macro food ad: neon-bokeh city, slow-motion levitating burger ingredients, steam, cheese pull; white brush-script slogan with the last word in red #e82830; hip-hop beat.
